curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach lane-use arrows, bike lanes, green conflict paint, banned bike-lane uses and shared lane markings.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on lane arrows and bike lanes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what yellow lines separate, broken, solid and double solid center lines, left edges, and the left-turn-only center lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per yellow line type; contrast cards for the passing rules and the center lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on yellow lines and passing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what a Michigan Left is, single and multi-lane crossovers, and the steps from the main highway and from the cross road.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Crossover and route cards; contrast card for unmarked crossovers.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach yield lines, white yield triangles, roundabout lane edges, and the ban on cutting through property around signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Yield marking cards; contrast card for triangles versus dashed lines.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach red, yellow and green lights, dark signals, and flashing red and yellow.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per light; contrast cards for steady versus flashing yellow and flashing red versus flashing yellow.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the doghouse signal and the flashing yellow arrow signal, with the meaning of each arrow.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per arrow; contrast cards for protected versus permissive turns.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach pedestrian signals, countdowns, WALK and DONT WALK, and the Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec11-m01..sec11-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Pavement markings, Michigan Lefts and traffic signals

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
